sn14.16:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || I Dhātuso va bhikkhave sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Hīnādhimuttikā hīnāmuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || Atītam pi bhikkhave addhānam dhātuso va sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu || Hīnādhimuttikā hīnādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu || ||
sn14.16:2.1: Anāgatam pi bhikkhave addhānam dhātuso va sattā saṃsandissanti samessanti || || Hīnādhimuttikā hīnādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandissanti samessanti || ||
sn14.16:3.1: Etarahi pi bhikkhave paccuppannam addhānam dhātuso va sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Hīnādhimuttikā hīnādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || ||
sn14.16:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave pi gūtho gūthena saṃsandati sameti || muttam muttena saṃsandati sameti || kheḷo kheḷena saṃsandati sameti || pubbo pubbena saṃsandati sameti || lohitam lohitena saṃsandati sameti || || Evam eva kho bhikkhave dhātuso va sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Hīnādhimuttikā hīnādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || Atītam pi addhānaṃ || pe|| || Anāgatam pi addhānaṃ || pe|| || Etarahi pi paccuppannam addhānaṃ dhātuso va sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Hīnādhimuttikā hīnādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || II
sn14.16:5.1: Dhātuso va bhikkhave sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Kalyāṇādhimuttikā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || Atītam pi bhikkhave addhānaṃ dhātuso va sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu || || Kalyāṇādhimuttikā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu ||
sn14.16:6.1: Anāgatam pi bhikkhave addhānaṃ || pe || || Etarahi pi bhikkhave paccuppannam addhānam dhātuso va sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Kalyāṇādhimuttikā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || ||
sn14.16:7.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave khīraṃ khīrena saṃsandati sameti || telaṃ telena saṃsandati sameti || sappi sappinā saṃsandati sameti || madhuṃ madhunā saṃsandati sameti || phāṇitaṃ phaṇitena saṃsandati sameti || Evam eva kho bhikkhave dhātuso va sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Kalyāṇādhimuttikā kalyānādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || || Atītam pi addhānaṃ || pe|| || Anāgatam pi addhānam || pe|| || Etarahi pi paccuppannam addhānaṃ dhātuso va sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Kalyaṇādhimuttikā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || ||
sn14.16:8.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || idaṃ vatvā ca Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
sn14.16:9.1: Saṃsaggā vanatho jāto || asaṃsaggena chijjati || parittam dārum āruyha || yathā sīde mahaṇṇave ||
sn14.16:10.1: Evaṃ kusītam āgamma || sādhujīvī pi sīdati || tasmā tam parivajjeyya || kusītaṃ hīnaviriyaṃ ||
sn14.16:11.1: Pavivittehi ariyehi || pahitattehi jhāyīhi || niccam āraddhaviriyehi || paṇḍitehi sahāvaseti || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
